description: Benign inputs for the memcached/hash port with the hash table in U (tracker item I9). Each case is a key space and the numbers of cache operations to run (about 60% get, 30% set, 10% delete, drawn with a fixed seed), followed by a walk over the whole table. The expectation is the output of the native build of the same hash table and hash function; no value is written by hand.
